title: Make it easier for Distributions to customize pinned applications on taskmanager applet
line: Distributions can set the Task Manager's default pinned apps with a taskmanager-extra-launchersrc file, the same way they already do for Kickoff's favorites.
explanation: The Task Manager's default pinned apps come only from its main.xml, which since the port to plasma_add_applet (6.6) is compiled into the plugin, so distributions can no longer patch or sed it and have to rebuild plasma-desktop. Kickoff already reads kicker-extra-favoritesrc from the XDG config dirs for the same purpose, but the Task Manager had nothing like it. The Task Manager (and Icons-only Task Manager) now has a small applet class that reads Prepend, Append and IgnoreDefaults from taskmanager-extra-launchersrc (e.g. /etc/xdg) and uses the result as its default launchers; plain desktop file names are turned into applications: URLs, and a list the user has changed is left alone.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: let distributions set the default launchers

Since the port to plasma_add_applet, main.xml is compiled in and distros
can no longer patch it to change the pinned apps. Read Prepend, Append
and IgnoreDefaults from taskmanager-extra-launchersrc, as Kickoff does.

BUG: 511560

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/taskmanagerapplet.cpp b/applets/taskmanager/taskmanagerapplet.cpp
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..86c373e37d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/taskmanagerapplet.cpp
@@ -0,0 +1,71 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+*/
+
+#include "taskmanagerapplet.h"
+
+#include <KConfig>
+#include <KConfigGroup>
+#include <KConfigLoader>
+
+#include <QDebug>
+#include <QTimer>
+#include <QUrl>
+
+using namespace Qt::StringLiterals;
+
+TaskManagerApplet::TaskManagerApplet(QObject *parent, const KPluginMetaData &data, const QVariantList &args)
+    : Plasma::Applet(parent, data, args)
+{
+}
+
+void TaskManagerApplet::init()
+{
+    // Let distributions change the default launchers, like kicker-extra-favoritesrc does for the launcher menus
+    KConfig config(u"taskmanager-extra-launchersrc"_s, KConfig::NoGlobals);
+    const KConfigGroup group = config.group(u"General"_s);
+    if (!group.exists()) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    m_launchersItem = dynamic_cast<KCoreConfigSkeleton::ItemStringList *>(configScheme()->findItemByName(u"launchers"_s));
+    if (!m_launchersItem) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const auto toLauncherUrls = [](const QStringList &ids) {
+        QStringList urls;
+        for (const QString &id : ids) {
+            urls << (QUrl(id).scheme().isEmpty() && id.endsWith(".desktop"_L1) ? u"applications:"_s + id : id);
+        }
+        return urls;
+    };
+
+    const QStringList prepend = toLauncherUrls(group.readXdgListEntry("Prepend", QStringList()));
+    const QStringList append = toLauncherUrls(group.readXdgListEntry("Append", QStringList()));
+    const bool ignoreDefaults = group.readEntry("IgnoreDefaults", false);
+
+    m_upstreamDefaultLaunchers = m_launchersItem->getDefault().toStringList();
+    m_launchersItem->setDefaultValue(prepend + (ignoreDefaults ? QStringList() : m_upstreamDefaultLaunchers) + append);
+
+    // Reload the configuration, also on the QML side which has already read it
+    Q_EMIT configScheme()->configChanged();
+}
+
+void TaskManagerApplet::configChanged()
+{
+    Plasma::Applet::configChanged();
+
+    // Reading the configuration falls back to the default from main.xml, not to the one set by the distribution
+    if (m_launchersItem && m_launchersItem->value() == m_upstreamDefaultLaunchers) {
+        m_launchersItem->setDefault();
+    }
+}
+
+K_PLUGIN_CLASS_WITH_JSON(TaskManagerApplet, "metadata.json")
+
+#include "taskmanagerapplet.moc"
+
+#include "moc_taskmanagerapplet.cpp"
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/taskmanagerapplet.h b/applets/taskmanager/taskmanagerapplet.h
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..4937dcb73e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/taskmanagerapplet.h
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+*/
+
+#pragma once
+
+#include <Plasma/Applet>
+
+#include <KCoreConfigSkeleton>
+
+class TaskManagerApplet : public Plasma::Applet
+{
+    Q_OBJECT
+
+public:
+    explicit TaskManagerApplet(QObject *parent, const KPluginMetaData &data, const QVariantList &args);
+
+    void init() override;
+    void configChanged() override;
+
+private:
+    KCoreConfigSkeleton::ItemStringList *m_launchersItem = nullptr;
+    QStringList m_upstreamDefaultLaunchers;
+};
--

media.caption: Pure master with /etc/xdg/taskmanager-extra-launchersrc (Prepend Konsole, Dolphin; Append Info Center; IgnoreDefaults=true): a new top panel and the untouched bottom panel still show the built-in System Settings, Discover, Files, Browser.
Same file with the fix: both Task Managers show Konsole, Dolphin and Info Center.

review.text: The need is real (main.xml is now compiled in, so distros can't change the default launchers), but the mechanism is fragile: it swaps the skeleton's default at init, re-emits configChanged, and after every reload re-applies the distro list whenever the stored value equals the upstream default, which also overrides a user who deliberately keeps exactly the upstream list. It also replaces GENERATE_APPLET_CLASS with a custom applet class just for this. The underlying problem (embedded main.xml defaults can't be overridden) affects every applet ported to plasma_add_applet and belongs in libplasma.
changes: Add a generic way in libplasma for distributions to override an applet's main.xml defaults from the XDG config dirs (e.g. a per-plugin defaults file applied to the config skeleton before it is read), so KConfigSkeleton itself falls back to the distro default

Then drop the Task Manager-specific applet class and the 'value == upstream default' comparison; at most keep the Prepend/Append/IgnoreDefaults convenience if maintainers want parity with kicker-extra-favoritesrc
